steps.content: The group escorts Manphist towards the interrogation room, but he moves with an unsettling composure, as if he were the one leading the way.
His demeanor suggests not a prisoner being questioned, but an examiner preparing to administer a test.

You know his reputation as a seasoned spy trainer; he is no ordinary adversary. To extract the intelligence you need on the Outlands and the Monolith, you must first find a single crack in his impeccable armor.
